name: LTY's Transit Expansion
description: LTY's Transit Expansion（LTE）是 Minecraft Transit Railway 的体验优化拓展：动态车头灯与车尾灯、随车移动的可视光柱、屏幕空间散射与雨雾水花、列车碰撞与撞飞、道床判定、粒子裁剪，以及信号灯 / 投影机 / PIDS 连接器和游戏内 3D 光束编辑器。服务端也安装时，碰撞、撞飞与伤害由服务端结算；只装客户端同样可以正常使用。 LTY's Transit Expansion (LTE) improves Minecraft Transit Railway: dynamic head and tail lights with visible moving beams, screen-space scattering, rain mist and track spray, train collisions and knock-back, trackbed detection, particle culling, plus signal, projector and PIDS linkers with an in-game 3D beam editor. Install it on the server as well and collisions, knock-back and damage are resolved server-side; a client-only install still works.
authors: 厦航在拍车的无名机长 (kigurumiLTY)
